bible.title: The Accidental Hero of Delphi
bible.premise: A coughing oracle mistook your bent walking crook for a divine spear, declaring you the chosen champion of Mount Parnassus. Now you must hike the sacred mountain to return your laurel wreath before legendary beasts challenge you to mortal combat.
bible.heart: You promised your loyal pet sheep, Celandine, that you would bring her safely back to pasture before the temple priests claim her as a holy sacrifice.
bible.goal: You must reach the inner sanctum of Delphi and convince the god Apollo to cancel your heroic destiny.
bible.danger: A furious true champion trails your footsteps to reclaim his prophecy, while ravenous beasts along the road expect an epic duel.
bible.world: The road climbs Mount Parnassus through three distinct trials: the Whispering Olive Grove, the Echoing Gorge of Riddles, and the sunlit terraces of Apollo's Great Temple. Gods meddle openly by trading favors for jokes or honey cakes, but their power obeys ancient custom. Every monster along the road is legally bound by sacred guest-friendship until formally challenged to a fight.

characters.name: Wrax
characters.description: A weary satyr trainer who needs to coach one genuine hero to earn his retirement, stubbornly treating your shepherd tricks as secret combat techniques.

characters.name: Aktor
characters.description: A muscle-bound warrior burdened with twelve bronze javelins, desperate to win back the glorious destiny he believes you stole from him.

characters.name: Myrina
characters.description: The sneeze-prone apprentice priestess who misread the holy laurel smoke and wants to quietly undo her paperwork blunder before Apollo notices.

characters.name: Varis
characters.description: A minor god of crossroads who manifests as an oversized lizard, amused by mortal mix-ups and willing to trade shortcuts for fresh goat cheese.

rules: A prophecy remains binding until the god who spoke it laughs aloud or accepts a formal refund.
Monsters cannot strike anyone who has not drawn a weapon or issued a formal heroic challenge.
Riddles carved into temple stones always possess simple, practical answers drawn from daily farm life.
Offering honest shepherd wisdom to a divine being earns one safe passage through sacred territory.

pages.text:
You tighten your grip on Celandine's fleece and back away from the altar. Your sheep chews lazily on clover, unaware that temple elders want to sacrifice her. Resting on your head is a scratchy wreath of sacred laurel. You never wanted glory; you only came to Delphi looking for a stray lamb.

"Hail, chosen champion," sneezes Myrina, waving away a cloud of burning herbs. The young apprentice priestess blinks at your muddy boots. "The oracle coughed, meaning your crook is a holy spear. Hand over the sheep for the altar fire, then go fight the beasts of Mount Parnassus."

If you surrender Celandine, she is gone forever. If you run, you insult the gods.

choices.text: Bolt down the temple steps with Celandine under your arm.
Bargain with Myrina to keep your sheep as a holy helper.

factsAdded.text: You wear the sacred laurel wreath of Apollo.
Myrina declared your walking crook to be the holy Spear of the Sun.
The temple priests intend to sacrifice your pet sheep Celandine.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a marble altar on the steps of a stone temple

pages.choiceText: Bolt down the temple steps with Celandine under your arm.
pages.text:
You scoop Celandine under one arm and scramble down the marble staircase. The fat sheep lets out an offended bleat, kicking her hooves like wild paddles. Behind you, the priests yell in outrage, but their heavy ceremonial robes make terrible running gear. You might actually reach the mountain road.

Then a wall of bronze blocks the lowest terrace. Aktor, a muscle-bound warrior bristling with twelve polished javelins, plants his sandals across the path. He glares at your laurel wreath with pure fury.

"Thief!" Aktor roars, his bronze armor rattling. "That glorious prophecy belongs to me! Surrender the sacred spear, or face my challenge!"

choices.text: Remind him that attacking an unarmed shepherd breaks holy law.
Dodge past his javelins and scramble down the cliffside.

factsAdded.text: Aktor the warrior is hunting you to reclaim his prophecy.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A panicked shepherd carrying a round sheep down a grand marble staircase.

pages.choiceText: Bargain with Myrina to keep your sheep as a holy helper.
pages.text:
"This is no ordinary sheep," you tell Myrina, pointing at her temple scroll. "She is a holy beast-hound. If your elders sacrifice her, Apollo will blame your paperwork when I fail."

Myrina bites her lip and hastily stamps the parchment. "Fine! Celandine is officially registered as your holy war-mount. Now run before the chief priest catches you. Hike up Mount Parnassus and get Apollo to cancel this before lunch!"

You slip through the rear gates onto the rocky trail. Clattering bronze shatters the morning quiet. A furious warrior carrying twelve bronze javelins blocks the path ahead. It is Aktor, and he glares at your laurel wreath with pure rage.

choices.text: Offer to surrender the laurel wreath to Aktor.
Bluff Aktor by brandishing your wooden crook.

factsAdded.text: Celandine is officially spared from sacrifice as your holy war-mount.
Aktor blocks the mountain trail to reclaim his prophecy.

pages.illustrationPrompt: an open temple scroll stamped with red wax

pages.choiceText: Remind him that attacking an unarmed shepherd breaks holy law.
pages.text:
You hold up an open hand and remind him that holy law forbids striking an unarmed traveler. Aktor freezes, his face flushing crimson beneath his bronze helmet. Sacred custom ties his hands, and the gods punish oath-breakers with sudden lightning. With a frustrated growl, he lowers his javelin.

A rustle shakes the dusty hedge beside the path. Out steps Wrax, a shaggy satyr chewing on a cedar twig. He claps his hands in delight. "Brilliant psychological warfare!" Wrax brays. "I am your official trainer, kid, and that bluff just earned my retirement paperwork a gold star."

Aktor glares at you both. "Surrender the wreath willingly," the warrior demands, "or I will trail you until you drop your guard."

choices.text: Bargain with Aktor to share the glory if he guides you.
Dart into the Whispering Olive Grove behind Wrax.

factsAdded.text: Wrax the satyr has joined you as your eager trainer.

pages.illustrationPrompt: An open hand held out to halt a charging warrior.

pages.choiceText: Dodge past his javelins and scramble down the cliffside.
pages.text:
You duck beneath Aktor's bronze spears and slide down the crumbly mountain cliff, clutching Celandine like a prize sack of grain. Loose shale clatters down the slope, leaving the shouting warrior stranded on the ledge above. You land safely on your feet beside a gnarled olive tree at the road's bend.

"Magnificent evasive roll!" rasps a voice from the brush. A weary satyr with curled horns and a wooden writing slate hobbles forward. "I am Wrax, master of champions. Thirty years I have waited for my final student to earn my retirement pension. That dirt dive was a masterstroke!"

Before you can explain, Wrax inspects your crook with reverent awe. High above, Aktor finds the winding mule path and begins marching down to cut you off.

choices.text: Confess you are an ordinary shepherd and ask for shelter.
Play along with his hero delusions to secure his guidance.

factsAdded.text: Wrax the satyr believes you are a legendary warrior.

pages.text:
Aktor narrows his eyes, weighing the offer. "A shared legend?" he rumbles. "Fine. I guide you up Mount Parnassus. When we meet Apollo, you confess that I am the true hero." You shake his heavy bronze gauntlet. Celandine gives an approving bleat against your ribs.

"A legendary coalition!" Wrax barks, trotting forward. "First test: the Whispering Olive Grove. The silver leaves catch every stray thought and chatter them aloud to the mountain." The wind rustles the trees with embarrassing farm secrets.

Aktor groans as the canopy loudly gossips about his fear of caterpillars. Ahead, an ancient, chattering trunk drops heavy branches to block the narrow path.

choices.text: Sing a loud sheep-herding tune to drown out the chatter.
Confess an embarrassing secret to satisfy the chattering tree.

factsAdded.text: Aktor agreed to guide you up the mountain in exchange for your glory.
You entered the Whispering Olive Grove.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A heavy bronze gauntlet clasping a shepherd's bare hand in an agreed bargain.

pages.choiceText: Dart into the Whispering Olive Grove behind Wrax.
pages.text:
You plunge into the Whispering Olive Grove, branches whipping your shoulders while Celandine grunts against your ribs. Silver leaves hiss above you like gossiping old men. Wrax trots ahead on cloven hooves, flicking his tail. "Keep moving, champion! Trees here tell secrets to anyone who listens, including that bronze meathead behind us."

A fat emerald lizard the size of a hunting hound lounges on a mossy boulder. It flicks a bright blue tongue at your tunic. "Hold on, mortals," the creature rasps in a booming voice. "I am Varis, god of crossroads. Give me fresh goat cheese, and I will show you the hidden temple trail."

Behind you, heavy bronze armor clatters through the brush. Aktor is closing fast.

choices.text: Offer Varis the dried sheep cheese from your shepherd pack.
Bypass the lizard god and sprint down the rocky gorge path.

factsAdded.text: Varis, god of crossroads, offered a shortcut to the temple in exchange for cheese.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a gnarled olive tree with twisted branches and shimmering silver leaves

pages.choiceText: Offer Varis the dried sheep cheese from your shepherd pack.
Bypass the lizard god and sprint down the rocky gorge path.
Sing a loud sheep-herding tune to drown out the chatter.
pages.text:
You belt out a rowdy shearing ballad at the top of your lungs. Your booming farm tune drowns out the chattering leaves completely. Baffled by the racket, the ancient olive tree groans and swings its heavy branches aside.

Beyond the grove, the trail splits before a dusty stone marker. Sunning on the rock sits an emerald lizard the size of a sheepdog. The reptile blinks lazy golden eyes. "Splendid shouting," says Varis, god of crossroads. "I can open a secret tunnel past the monster-filled gorge. My fee is simple: fresh goat cheese."

Aktor scowls and rattles his bronze javelins. "Real heroes march through the gorge to face glory! Bribing giant geckos is shepherd cowardice!"

choices.text: Trade your lunch cheese to take Varis's hidden tunnel.
Refuse the shortcut and march with Aktor into the gorge.

factsAdded.text: Varis, god of crossroads, offered a tunnel shortcut in exchange for goat cheese.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a gnarled ancient olive tree lifting its heavy branches

pages.choiceText: Confess an embarrassing secret to satisfy the chattering tree.
pages.text:
You step up to the knotted tree and whisper your secret: you once blamed Celandine for eating the village headman's prize turnip. The branches shiver with squeaky giggles, chattering the confession to the wind before swinging aside to clear the trail.

"Unorthodox psychological combat!" Wrax brays, nodding with deep respect. Aktor only grunts and adjusts his heavy quiver of javelins.

Beyond the grove, the path forks around a flat boulder. Basking in the sun sits Varis, an oversized emerald lizard wearing a tiny bronze collar. "Amusing confession, shepherd," Varis rasps, flicking a blue tongue. "I am Varis of the crossroads. Give me fresh goat cheese, and I will reveal the easy shortcut." You carry cheese in your pouch, but Aktor is already lifting a javelin to drive the reptile off.

choices.text: Offer your goat cheese to Varis for the shortcut.
Let Aktor threaten the oversized lizard with his javelin.

factsAdded.text: You passed the Whispering Olive Grove without injury.
You met Varis, an oversized lizard god of crossroads who wants cheese.
